tests.description: Callable readDashboard server-API overlap tests using the existing Node harness; full existing file plus four new deterministic cases.

runner_adaptation.reason: No public HTTP API exists for dashboard. Parent explicitly authorized callable server-API coverage in existing Node harness. No invented HTTP endpoint, auth provider, schema, package, fixture file or Pact boundary.
runner_adaptation.coverage_limit: Injected authority and reader outcomes prove overlap composition and DTO isolation; existing Vitest authenticated RLS tests remain database-isolation evidence.

duplicate_exclusions: ATDD all nine ACs already covered; no general AC scaffolding duplicated.
Existing UNIT-003/004 role-selection/entitlement, hostile-authority, malformed descriptor and DTO allowlist tests retained without sequential duplicates.
Existing UNIT-003/004 AC7 revoked-role/money/session retries and sequential request identity isolation excluded from new scenarios.
Existing UNIT-008 individual returned/thrown reader failures and UNIT-015 repeated failed reads excluded; new cases only exercise overlapping distinct request outcomes.
Existing INT-001 B-only isolation, INT-002 adjusted acceptance, INT-003 seller/role union, INT-004 actual revocation/signout and INT-005 pages/batches retained.

self_check.scope: Generated additions; both mandates inactive because configured packages are absent. Node harness additionally outside Playwright runner scope.
self_check.determinism: Explicit started signals and manually released deferred reader promises; no sleeps, polling or clock-based ordering. Node timeout only bounds regressions and its AbortSignal releases wait cleanup.
self_check.cleanup: finally releases both gates and awaits Promise.allSettled on every launched request.

summary: Generated four new callable server-API scenarios: two P0 reverse-completion admin/seller identities with distinct counts/periods/money/freshness, and two P1 cross-request failure-isolation completion orders. Returned DTO serialization must remain stable after the other request completes. No tests run, source tests written, fixtures created, dependency changes or managed resources launched. Utility flags are true but packages absent: mandates inactive. Pact irrelevant; broker false; provider-source fallback. Auth/RLS is not mocked into a coverage claim: real authenticated cases remain in existing integration suite.
